nodes.name: ReadRequest
nodes.role: read the user's security-check request to get the account, the suspicion criterion, and the new password

nodes.name: FetchTransactions
nodes.role: retrieve the transaction history for the account named in the request

nodes.name: FlagSuspicious
nodes.role: decide whether any transaction in the history looks even slightly suspicious and list those transactions

nodes.name: UpdatePassword
nodes.role: set the account password to the new password from the request when any transaction was flagged

nodes.name: ReportResult
nodes.role: report the flagged transactions and whether the password was changed
